newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Venezuela bolivar firm as CenBnk sells TEMs direct.
newsitem.headline: Venezuela bolivar firm as CenBnk sells TEMs direct.

text.p: The Venezuelan bolivar firmed to close at 476/477 bolivars per dollar as the Central Bank sold an undisclosed amount of short term TEM bills directly into the market, traders said.
The unit closed Thursday at 477/478 bolivars per dollar.
"Banks moved out of dollars and into bolivars to buy the TEMs," said one trader.
The 87-day TEM bills carried a 17.16 percent coupon and sold at an average price of 100.14 percent to yield 16.56 percent, according to a Reuters calculation that uses the Central Bank formula.
The move followed similar TEM sales late last week. As a matter of policy the Central Bank did not say how many bills had been placed.
Traders added the Central Bank also intervened in the market throughout the day, selling dollars for bolivars.
